site.name: ORI 369
site.tagline: Your Bridge Between Science and Energy
site.description: At ORI 369, we combine cutting-edge therapeutic approaches, the latest technologies, and a deep understanding of 3-6-9 frequencies to help you achieve balance of body, mind, and spirit.
site.address: Ulica škofa Maksimilijana Držečnika 11, 2000 Maribor, Slovenia

therapies.name: Electrostimulation
therapies.shortDescription: Electrical impulses create controlled muscle activation.
therapies.fullDescription: During the session, electrodes on the skin emit gentle electrical impulses. The intensity is adjusted individually and feels like rhythmic muscle activation.

therapies.name: Myofascial Massage
therapies.shortDescription: Gentle hands-on techniques for relaxing muscles and fascia.
therapies.fullDescription: The session uses hands-on techniques adapted to the individual, with a focus on relaxing tense areas and comfortable movement.

therapies.name: TECAR Session
therapies.fullDescription: During the session, a pleasant deep warmth develops in the tissue while tense areas are addressed manually.

therapies.name: Magnetic Stimulation
therapies.shortDescription: Magnetic stimulation in a relaxed lying position.
therapies.fullDescription: The device creates a pulsed magnetic field. You lie comfortably during this non-invasive session.

therapies.name: MIS (Magnetic Induction Stimulation)
therapies.fullDescription: An applicator above the selected area creates pulses that feel like rhythmic muscle activation.

therapies.name: Laser Session
therapies.shortDescription: A non-invasive session using laser light.
therapies.fullDescription: The selected area is exposed to a laser device. The process is brief and usually produces no pronounced sensation.

therapies.name: Medi Taping
therapies.shortDescription: Application of elastic tape to a selected area.
therapies.fullDescription: Elastic tape is applied to the skin according to the desired support and movement. It remains flexible during everyday activities.

therapies.name: Cupping
therapies.shortDescription: A hands-on cupping technique for a relaxing sensation.
therapies.fullDescription: The cups create gentle suction on the skin. Intensity and duration are adjusted to the individual.

therapies.name: IteraCare Relaxation
therapies.shortDescription: Warm relaxation using an IteraCare device.
therapies.fullDescription: The device directs warm airflow at selected areas, creating a pleasant sensation of warmth during the session.

therapies.name: Traction Table
therapies.shortDescription: Gentle spinal stretching on a traction table.
therapies.fullDescription: The traction table provides controlled stretching adapted to the individual in a relaxed lying position.

therapies.name: Scalar Wave Relaxation
therapies.shortDescription: A calm relaxation session alongside the Scalar Wave device.
therapies.fullDescription: The session takes place in a calm setting alongside the Scalar Wave device and is intended as a relaxing experience.

therapies.name: Individual Guided Breathing
therapies.shortDescription: Guided breathing exercises for calm and relaxation.
therapies.fullDescription: A practitioner guides you through an adapted breathing rhythm, with exercises you can later include in everyday life.

explanation.why_numbers_work: Packages differ by the number of visits, price per visit and follow-up period. Choose the scope that best suits your schedule and goals.
explanation.why_ori369_works: At ORI 369, we combine technology, hands-on techniques, relaxation and movement in a personal plan.
explanation.simple_comparison: Devices and hands-on techniques are selected according to the agreed session plan. Before starting, we explain the process and the sensation you can expect.

holistic_approach.description: When preparing a personal plan, we consider different aspects of everyday well-being:
aspects: what relationship they have with themselves
what relationship they have with others
what relationship they have with nature and earth
holistic_approach.result: A personal plan connects movement, relaxation and everyday habits into a clear whole.
